author: /root/girtas_se_walk_author adapting original fresh author fixed camera/projection and ROOT-approved actual new sole roots; independent reviewer separate

projection.method: At each foot, project groundY=m*root_relative_screenX+K*lateral_screenX. Ground has separate lateral slices; groundY is not one flat imageY and forward stride changes groundY. Actual painted sole points are observed; world floor, lateral coordinate and root are authored with explicit intervals.
projection.ground_lateral_intervals: far support -50 +/-8 canonical; near support +79 +/-8. AIR far[-54,-44], near[65,87]. More compact far/near stride placement than neutral resting shoe spread is allowed.
projection.projection_camera_pitch_uncertainty: Camera targetZ in [0,1] would change slopes. This candidate uses the existing guide targetZ1 consistently; guide generic .57 bones never establish source anatomy.
projection.foot_orientation: heel/toe rolls and shoe thickness retained; load support samples need not have identical groundY

root_authorship.method: Ground contact0/1 FAR_LEFT and3/4 NEAR_RIGHT pinned from actual selected sole. RootX authored using visible waist and actual thigh-chain intervals, with finite fore/aft and lateral stance; contact rootY follows projected ground equation. AIR2/5 use transparent virtualground and true positive per-foot sole clearances. Horizontal torso motion is retained, including phase5 root anterior of visible waist; hidden hip is an interval, not a clothV point.

cycle_observations.warning_for_independent_decision: New bounded contacts replace the old stretched legs; unchanged AIR5-to0 has a large uppercore drop that still requires actual cycle judgment. The candidate exposes this rather than resizing accepted C or flattening soles. Independent actual-body/entry/cycle judgment must decide plausibility; author does not grant PASS.

region_operation: Only outward disjoint metadata room, no PNG edits; original alpha16 ownership and strict guards remain unchanged.
